novelty.justification: The central novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: the claim predicts that “a small set of query-form-specific attention heads act as routers whose failure predicts and causes recall failure across forms,” distinguishing form-invariant storage from form-dependent retrieval circuits. Searches using “prompt syntax factual knowledge retrieval LLM,” “paraphrase query form activation patching factual recall,” and “attention heads router factual retrieval” identify Decoding Prompt Syntax (2023) as the closest behavioral study and Mechanistic Understanding and Mitigation of Language Model Non-Factual Hallucinations (2024) as the closest mechanistic study, but the former measures only performance under syntactic variation while the latter separates enrichment from answer-extraction failures without comparing matched query forms. Moving from those works to causal cross-form circuit divergence, form-selective router heads, and transfer of a retrieval pathway from a successful form to a failing form requires a new core relationship rather than merely changing the prompt object, although it remains within established factual-recall and activation-intervention frameworks.
